status_rule: PASS only if every check below passed in this run (row written on the primary read back on the standby, streaming, slot, TLS, healthcheck negative test, clean teardown); FAIL if any failed; else UNMEASURED

primary-init.sh ran at initdb (role, slot, pg_hba)

checks.title: No FATAL / permission errors in the primary log during bootstrap + clone
Row inserted on the primary is readable on the standby
checks.detail: primary write exit 0; standby returned 'r01-6f5abec88575c6ed' (expected nonce r01-6f5abec88575c6ed); first seen after 0.48s over 1 polls

checks.title: Primary pg_stat_replication shows postgres_dr_standby streaming
Physical slot postgres_dr_standby exists and is active
Replication connection is TLS (hostssl + sslmode=require)
Only the replication role may replicate remotely, scram, samenet
Replication role exists, LOGIN REPLICATION, not superuser
Primary archive_command succeeds (archived_count > 0, failed_count = 0)
Standby is in recovery and its WAL receiver is streaming via the slot
pg_basebackup -R wrote standby.signal
primary_conninfo written by -R carries no password (passfile only)
checks.detail: exit 0; primary_conninfo present=True; 'password=' present=False; passfile present=True

checks.title: Replication password unset before exec of the server
Standby is read-only (hot standby)
checks.detail: exit 1; ERROR:  cannot execute INSERT in a read-only transaction

checks.title: Docker reports the standby healthy
Standby healthcheck exits non-zero once streaming stops
Standby reconnects and streams again after the primary restarts
Proof project containers + volumes removed
checks.detail: down exit 0; volumes left []; containers left []

observations.proof_override_yaml:
# proof-only override (r01 DR replication proof): no host ports, no restart,
# TLS cert/key for prod's ssl=on (image snakeoil pair; prod uses a Vault cert)
services:
  postgres-prod:
    ports: !reset []
    restart: "no"
    command: ["postgres", "-c", "wal_level=replica", "-c", "max_wal_senders=10", "-c", "max_replication_slots=10", "-c", "max_slot_wal_keep_size=16GB", "-c", "archive_mode=on", "-c", "archive_command=test ! -f /var/lib/postgresql/wal_archive/%f && cp %p /var/lib/postgresql/wal_archive/%f", "-c", "ssl=on", "-c", "shared_buffers=2GB", "-c", "work_mem=64MB", "-c", "ssl_cert_file=/etc/ssl/certs/ssl-cert-snakeoil.pem", "-c", "ssl_key_file=/etc/ssl/private/ssl-cert-snakeoil.key"]
  postgres-dr:
    ports: !reset []
    restart: "no"
observations.standby_healthcheck: psql -XtA -U "${PG_REPLICATION_USER}" -d postgres -c "SELECT pg_is_in_recovery() AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_stat_wal_receiver WHERE status = 'streaming')" | grep -qx t
